title: Maiorana–McFarland bentness
statement: For every natural number $n$ and every function $g$ from the $n$-dimensional binary cube to the signs, the function on the $2n$-dimensional binary cube given by the Maiorana–McFarland construction is bent: every Fourier coefficient has absolute value $2^{-n}$.
